theorems.name: Submission.imrep_carrier_inter_null_of_vanishesOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → μHE[n] (R.carrier ∩ W) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
